paragraphs.text:
You dart after the fleeing guide. Within a minute you are out 
of sight of the camp. Even under the shadows of the fir and 
spruce, you can tell by the pallid ground that snow has fallen.

You yell Charlie’s name at the top of your lungs, startled by 
the raucous echo that answers you. Feeling helpless before the 
vastness of the dark woods, you are ready to retreat when a wail 
comes from high above.

To look up in the sky, go to 72. To cover your face and ears until the 
impossible cry ceases, go to 109.
